summary:
Public Law 119-6 (H.J. Res. 20) exercises Congress’s authority under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code (the Congressional Review Act), to disapprove a final rule submitted by the Department of Energy. The targeted rule, titled "Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Consumer Gas-fired Instantaneous Water Heaters," was published in the Federal Register on December 26, 2024 (89 Fed. Reg. 105188). 

The joint resolution provides that Congress disapproves the specified rule and declares that the rule "shall have no force or effect." This operative language effects a statutory repeal of the rule, preventing its implementation and enforcement. Under the standard operation of chapter 8 of title 5, U.S. Code, this disapproval also precludes the promulgation of any subsequent rule that is substantially the same, unless specifically authorized by a subsequent statute.

The joint resolution was approved by the President on May 9, 2025, establishing the effective date of the rule's nullification. The text contains no exceptions, conditions precedent, or appropriations.
